description: Uses `theme` or `style` to establish a font
notes:
`font_theme` will make use of any `theme` variable. Themes hold the context of aesthetic, such as "pirate", "scifi", "grunge".
`font_style` will make use of any `style` variable. This is more or less the artistic medium of photographic style.
If neither is present, a fallback will occur. Theme takes some priority over style since it's typically more prevalent to the font choice.

Note that some of these are not actual fonts, but rather descriptors of the type of font. But we can definitely include literal fonts too.
